==Notes==
*Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
*If ended by the caster's [[death]], this skill also resurrects the caster.
*Unlike [[Lively Was Naomei]], Eternal Aura revives instantly and is the only skill that can prevent a [[wipe]]. 
*Equipping [[List_of_enchantment_removal_skills#On_self|enchantment removal skills]] or [[Teardown#List of teardown skills|teardown skills]] that do not rely on combat will allow the user to resurrect on command.
{{bug|This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of [[Frozen Soil]].}}
